3. The case for accused appellant Mobarak Hossain is that he does not know anything about the murder of Abdur Rouf. The seized blood stained knife Ext. II and panjabi Ext. III do not belong to accused appellant Mobarak. P.W. 6 Bazlu had quarrel with Haji Motiar Rahman over the boundary of their land and P.W. 6 Bazlu out of grudge has implicated accused appellant Mobarak in this case falsely. The further defence of accused appellant Mobarak is that Badsha Mia, father of Haji Motiar Rahman (maternal uncle of accused appellant Mobarak) filed Title Suit No. 8 of 1971 in the First Court of Munsif, Brahman Baria for permanent injunction regarding 3.17 acres of land of Mouza Shabajpur, P.S. Sarail against 17 defendants including 2 proforma defendants and that accused Zillu's father Abdul Momen was made proforma defendant No. 16. That suit was decreed ex-parte on 5.4.73. The further defence case of accused appellant Mobarak Hossain was that his relations such as P.W. 17 Ratan Mia could not tolerate accused appellant Mobarak as he was the most educated person in the family. 

 4. The prosecution examined 19 witnesses. Defence did not examine any witness. In his examination under section 342 Cr. P.C. accused appellant Mobarak submitted certified copies of the plaint, the exparte decree and the order dated 5.4.73 of Title Suit No. S of 1971 of the First Court of Munsif, Brahman Baria in his effort to show that his maternal uncle's father Badsha Mia had made accused Zillu's father Abdul Momen a proforma defendant in the said Title Suit No. 8 of 1971 which was decreed exparte and so accused Zillu implicated him in this case out of grudge in his statement. 

 12. Accused appellant Mobarak Hossain during his examination under section 342 Cr. P.C. filed, the certified copies of the plaint, exparte decree and the order dated 5-4-73 of title suit No. 8 o f 1971 of the First Court of the Munsif, Brahman Baria. It was a suit for permanent injunction filed by accused appellant Mobarak's maternal grandfather Badsha Mia against 15 principal defendants and 2 proforma defendants' in respect of certain land. In the said suit accused Zillu's father Abdul Momin was made proforma defendant No. 16. None of the defendants contested the suit and the suit was decreed exparte. From these facts it has not become probable in any manner that accused Zillu had any grudge, enmity or malice against accused appellant Mobarak Hossain.
